acceptance: A planner runs the open brainstorm session multi-operator-0-3-2 (technical lens) through both rounds with its seed notes, records the ideas with specy-road brainstorm add-idea, and recommends a ranked set with specy-road brainstorm recommend
The maintainer accepts or rejects the recommended ideas; accepted ones are promoted to roadmap nodes for 0.3.2 with specy-road brainstorm promote, and the session is closed
Nothing is built in this leaf: its output is the brainstorm record and the promoted nodes
nodes.title: Run the multi-operator brainstorm for 0.3.2 (two or more operators on several machines, plus a PM in the PM GUI)

acceptance: A worker turn that merges or fast-forwards the integration branch reports no committed_outside_zones finding for paths changed only by commits reachable from the integration ref; a path the leaf's own commit changes outside its zones is still reported
The check reads the integration ref the worker state already records, and an unreadable ref is a check_error finding, never a silent pass
One test through the public post-run check covers both cases (integration-only path, leaf-own out-of-zone path); CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry
nodes.title: The post-run zone check counts only the leaf's own commits, not integration commits a merge brings in
